name: net.paisan/paisan
title: Paisán
description: Search suppliers and products on Paisán, the sourcing platform to find Latin American manufacturers.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Search manufacturers and exporters across Latin America listed on Paisán, by what they make. Returns up to 20 suppliers per page with category, city, country, a short summary and a profile link. Every supplier is named. No contact details are included. To contact a supplier, send the buyer to its profileUrl on paisan.net (free to search). Software agents can buy one supplier's contact record through Paisán's paid agent API (/api/agent/v1/suppliers/{id}, see https://paisan.net/openapi.json).

query.description: What the buyer is looking for, in English, Spanish or Portuguese, e.g. "cotton denim fabric".

country.description: Optional. Country name in English, e.g. "Mexico", "Brazil", "Colombia".

category.description: Optional. Supplier category exactly as Paisán names it, e.g. "Textiles".

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalogue of Latin American suppliers on Paisán. Returns up to 20 products per page with price as listed (or "Request Quote"), minimum order, category, origin and the supplier's id. Every supplier is named. No contact details are included. To contact a supplier, send the buyer to its profileUrl on paisan.net (free to search). Software agents can buy one supplier's contact record through Paisán's paid agent API (/api/agent/v1/suppliers/{id}, see https://paisan.net/openapi.json).

query.description: What the buyer is looking for, in English, Spanish or Portuguese, e.g. "cotton denim fabric".

country.description: Optional. Country name in English, e.g. "Mexico", "Brazil", "Colombia".

category.description: Optional. Product category exactly as Paisán names it.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier's public facts on Paisán by id: category, location, summary, what it makes, industries served, number of products and profile link. Every supplier is named. No contact details are included. To contact a supplier, send the buyer to its profileUrl on paisan.net (free to search). Software agents can buy one supplier's contact record through Paisán's paid agent API (/api/agent/v1/suppliers/{id}, see https://paisan.net/openapi.json).

id.description: The supplier id from a search result.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product on Paisán by id, with its full description, listed price, minimum order, origin, its supplier's id and the product page link. Every supplier is named.

id.description: The product id from a search result.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Latin American suppliers and their products on Paisán at once. Returns up to 10 of each as { id, title, url }; pass an id to fetch for the details. Every supplier is named.

query.description: What the buyer is looking for, in English, Spanish or Portuguese, e.g. "cotton denim fabric".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The details of one result from search, by its id ("supplier:…" or "product:…"). Every supplier is named. No contact details are included. To contact a supplier, send the buyer to its profileUrl on paisan.net (free to search). Software agents can buy one supplier's contact record through Paisán's paid agent API (/api/agent/v1/suppliers/{id}, see https://paisan.net/openapi.json).

id.description: An id from the search tool, such as "supplier:abc123" or "product:xyz".
